sources.title: AI Receipt Processing: How It Works | ReceiptsAI
sources.snippet: AI receipt processing is an automated technology that uses artificial intelligence to read, understand, and extract information from receipts, invoices, and other financial documents. Unlike traditional manual data entry or basic OCR, AI-powered systems can understand context, recognize patterns, and make intelligent decisions about how to categorize and structure your financial data.
